task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with three closure-ready player-facing repairs: restore cemetery spatial integrity, add first-run guidance and readable build choices, and complete the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper route with clean result/retry lifecycle.

diagnosis.root_cause: Fresh gameplay still skips contextual onboarding, the shipped camera's occluder binding hides all three authored landmarks, and ordinary progression remains at warmup/zero of five with only fixture-assisted terminal coverage. Prior treatments emphasized evidence and transform tuning; this iteration needs explicit UI-state repair, sightline/collision isolation, and authoritative route-state repair.

stop_conditions: Preserve native_godot_project, host_godot_boot, validated mesh imports, and the intact authored cemetery package.
Do not replace or surgically edit preserved assets without explicit package-incompatibility evidence.
Do not schedule deferred dense-performance work or evidence-only work as a substitute for these three product surfaces.
Stop after bounded candidate implementation and focused self-checks; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own recapture, verdicts, and issue closure.

strategy.rationale: Treat the active issues as three independent root-cause families. Use explicit camera sightline/collision-layer isolation around the intact authored map, authoritative InputMap-driven onboarding and choice presentation, and a contiguous ordinary route state machine. This is materially different from prior transform/evidence-only treatments.

code: Run focused Godot script parse/import checks for all modified files and verify no fatal startup/runtime errors.
Check that each required gap is covered exactly once and each active issue id is assigned exactly once.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester should recapture a fresh title-to-gameplay onboarding sequence, device/focus changes, ordinary movement and camera probes, four cardinal cemetery views, five-wave progression, Bellkeeper phases, Result, Retry, and Title cleanup.
Capture runtime state, scene-tree/spatial/collision evidence, screenshots, input receipts, route snapshots, and lifecycle reset receipts; Tester owns pass/fail and issue closure.
visual: Inspect shipped-camera frames for larger traversable scale, external depth, landmark visibility and collision readability; inspect onboarding and upgrade-card visual hierarchy, silhouettes/icons, current-to-new values, stat-delta restraint, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states; inspect wave/boss telegraphs and Result/Retry composition at the acceptance resolution.

done_when: The playable arena has a larger traversable scale, with before/after playable extents and time-to-cross observable in movement replay.
The external world provides visible external depth beyond the gameplay boundary at multiple perimeter/cardinal views.
Each central building or landmark (keeper post, mausoleum, cracked moon bell) has nonzero shipped-camera visibility before approach, near contact, and after departure.
Grounded collision remains aligned with rendered landmark geometry and prevents player/enemy pass-through without invisible barriers.
No landmark disappearance or whole-landmark occlusion occurs during ordinary movement; camera-aware sightline handling is selective and reversible.
The boundary/perimeter is coherent, with no void or proxy-floor substitute, and escape lanes remain readable.
Tester can run four cardinal views plus horizontal mouse motion that changes yaw/camera_forward and vertical motion that changes pitch.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authored cemetery package through explicit sightline and collision ownership rather than another camera transform tweak. In the native cemetery scene and spatial contract, isolate MausoleumCollision and other tall occluders from landmark visibility queries, keep gameplay collision aligned to rendered footprints, and bind additive outer-world/perimeter datum only where needed. Rebase spawn, objective, navigation, and camera coverage to native streets; preserve the intact map instance and expose keeper post, mausoleum, and cracked moon bell through shipped-camera before/near/after traversal evidence.
tasks.title: Restore cemetery scale, landmarks, and collision sightlines

done_when: A fresh title-to-gameplay route presents contextual, dismissible guidance for movement, dash, automatic attacks, pickup/drop collection, and the first upgrade choice while ordinary systems remain active.
Guidance labels and glyphs derive from the authoritative InputMap and update when the active keyboard/gamepad device changes.
A dismissed sequence is discoverable through Controls/Help, does not consume combat input or pause the run, and does not replay on Retry after completion.

Each upgrade/weapon choice uses a clear visual hierarchy, leads with authored silhouettes or icons and compact stat icons, and shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas.
CURRENT values never use NEW or LOCKED placeholders; unchanged, zero, and unrelated rows are omitted.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, newly-unlocked, and selected states are visibly distinct without changing card dimensions.
The normal HUD and full-screen draft remain readable at the configured shipped resolution and UI scale.
tasks.instructions: Repair the real onboarding and upgrade-draft presenters, not telemetry. Make the first-run sequence advance from authoritative movement/dash/attack/pickup/level-up predicates, render live InputMap bindings and device context, and provide a help rediscovery path with deterministic QA reset isolation. Refine the existing upgrade cards around a clear visual hierarchy with authored silhouettes or icons, compact stat rows, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states while preserving exactly-once choice application and pause ownership.
tasks.title: Make first-run guidance and build choices usable

done_when: A fresh ordinary run records the five authored wave ids contiguously in order and visibly advances wave-state progression.
Wave 1 teaches movement, auto-attacks, and collection; later waves add composition and elite pressure; spawning respects live caps and terminal ownership.
The Bellkeeper appears only after the ordinary route, exposes its actionable two-phase encounter, and commits exactly one victory or failure terminal.
Victory or failure transitions to a Result screen showing outcome, time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt/taken, selected upgrades, and build summary.
Retry and Return to Title reset actors, wave/director state, upgrades, objectives, pause ownership, audio, and result flags without stale callbacks or duplicate terminal commits.
Tester has direct black-box and white-box predicates for wave ids, boss request count, terminal commit count, Result presentation, and clean Retry.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative run director and lifecycle ledger so ordinary play—not diagnostic preparation—advances first_toll, crossing_shadows, gravewind, long_procession, then bellkeeper. Make wave transitions, spawn pacing, elite/boss cues, Bellkeeper request/defeat, terminal commit, Result presentation, and Retry reset state-bound and exactly-once. Keep tester-only prepare/advance actions isolated from release exports while exposing stable snapshots and reset receipts for same-loop retest.
tasks.title: Complete the five-wave Bellkeeper route
